name: Sculpt tools in the world editor
body: A Terrain tool in the editor: a Generate panel (seed, feature size, octaves, amplitude, size) that makes or regenerates a terrain, brushes (raise, lower, smooth, flatten) with radius and strength and a ring under the cursor, erosion, and every stroke one undo step through the existing preview and CommitPreview.

comments.text: Terrain tab (Alt+6) with raise, lower, smooth and flatten brushes, a brush ring, generate, regenerate and erode actions, each one undo step. Decisions D-270 to D-272. Test: engine/tests/editor/terrain-tools-sculpt-and-undo.

Second slice: noise, terrace and erode brushes, four falloffs, Ctrl invert and Shift smooth, a Terrain menu, a toolbar brush button (B), [ and ] resize, choices remembered between runs. D-273 to D-275.
